summary: Suzano S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing excerpts of minutes from an August 12, 2026 board meeting. The board acknowledged the resignation of Aires Galhardo as Statutory Executive Vice President of Pulp Operations, Engineering, Energy, DigitalTech and New Businesses, and elected Carlos Anibal Fernandes de Almeida Júnior as his replacement, with an expanded portfolio including Supply Chain and FuturaGene. The resignation and election were approved unanimously. This is a routine executive transition, not a market-moving event, and no deal terms or strategic actions were disclosed. The filing is a standard Brazilian corporate governance update reported on Form 6-K.
